run_f_gold: run f_gold to count missing elements in the range between min and max of an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using parameterized test cases with arrays and lengths
summarize_f_gold: summarize how f_gold uses a dictionary to track present elements and count missing ones
review_f_gold: review f_gold for correctness when counting missing integers in the min to max range
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a set instead of a dict for tracking present elements
